questions.stem: What is the speed of the hour hand in degrees per hour?
questions.keySolution:
Hour hand completes \(360°\) in \(12\) hours
Speed = \(360 / 12 = 30°\) per hour

questions.stem: The minute hand moves \(6°\) per minute. How many degrees will it move in \(10\) minutes?
questions.keySolution:
Distance = Speed × Time
= \(6 × 10 = 60°\)

questions.stem: The minute hand is at \(12\) and the hour hand is at \(4\). What is the angle between them?
At what time between \(1:00\) and \(2:00\) will the hands overlap (coincide)?
questions.keySolution:
First coincidence after \(12:00\) is at \(12/11\) hours
Second is at \(2 × (12/11) ≈ 1:05:27\)

questions.stem: Between \(3:00\) and \(4:00\), at what time will the hands be opposite (\(180°\) apart)?
questions.keySolution: Using the formula for opposite hands between hours, this occurs at approximately \(3:49:05\)

questions.stem: What is the relative speed between the minute and hour hands in degrees per minute?
questions.keySolution:
Relative speed = Speed of minute hand - Speed of hour hand
= \(6 - 0.5 = 5.5°\) per minute

questions.stem: The hands are together at \(12:00\). At what time will they first be opposite (\(180°\) apart)?
questions.keySolution:
Time for \(180°\) separation = \(180 / 5.5 = 360/11 ≈ 32.73\) minutes
This is approximately \(12:32:44\) which extends to \(6:32:44\) PM by symmetry or calculation

questions.stem: What is the speed of the hour hand of a clock in degrees per minute?
questions.keySolution:
Hour hand completes \(360°\) in \(12\) hours = \(720\) minutes
Speed = \(360 / 720 = 0.5°\) per minute

questions.stem: At \(3:30\), what is the angle between hour and minute hands?
In \(12\) hours, how many times do the hands overlap?
questions.keySolution: Hands coincide \(11\) times in \(12\) hours (not at \(11\)-\(12\) junction separately)

questions.stem: How many times in \(12\) hours are the hands of a clock at right angles?
questions.keySolution:
Hands are at \(90°\) twice between each coincidence
With \(11\) coincidences in \(12\) hours, there are \(22\) right angles

questions.stem: What is the speed of the minute hand of a clock in degrees per minute?
questions.keySolution:
Minute hand completes \(360°\) in \(60\) minutes
Speed = \(360 / 60 = 6°\) per minute

questions.stem: The hour hand moves \(0.5°\) per minute. How many degrees will it move in \(60\) minutes?
questions.keySolution:
Distance = Speed × Time
= \(0.5 × 60 = 30°\)

questions.stem: At \(2:00\), what is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.keySolution:
At \(2:00\): Hour hand at \(60°\), Minute hand at \(0°\)
Angle = \(60 - 0 = 60°\)

questions.stem: At \(9:15\), how many degrees has the hour hand moved from \(12\) o'clock position?
Starting at \(12:00\) when hands coincide, after how many minutes will they be perpendicular for the first time?
What is the relationship between the minute hand's gain and relative motion?
options: Minute hand gains \(330°\) per hour on hour hand
questions.keySolution:
Relative speed = \(5.5° / min = 330° / hour\)
Minute hand continuously gains on hour hand at this rate

questions.stem: At what positions do the hands form a right angle (\(90°\)) first after \(3:00\)?
questions.keySolution:
At \(3:00\), angle = \(90°\) already
Next is after minute hand moves further
They form \(90°\) at specific times when relative position = \(90°\)

questions.stem: What is the speed of the minute hand in degrees per hour?
questions.keySolution:
Minute hand completes one full rotation (\(360°\)) in \(1\) hour
Speed = \(360°\) per hour

questions.stem: How long will the minute hand take to gain \(360°\) (one complete lap) on the hour hand?
questions.keySolution:
Time = Angle / Relative Speed
= \(360 / 5.5 = 720/11 ≈ 65.45\) minutes

questions.stem: In how many hours will the hands of a clock coincide (overlap) for the second time after \(12:00\)?
questions.keySolution:
Hands coincide every \(720/11\) minutes = \(65.45\) minutes
Second coincidence after \(12:00\) is at approximately \(1:05\) which is about \(1.09\) hours

questions.stem: The minute hand is at \(12\) and the hour hand is at \(1\). How many minutes until they overlap?
questions.keySolution:
Initial gap = \(30°\) (one hour mark)
Time to overlap = Gap / Relative Speed
= \(30 / 5.5 = 60/11 ≈ 5.45\) minutes

questions.stem: How much faster does the minute hand move than the hour hand in degrees per minute?
questions.keySolution:
Difference = \(6 - 0.5 = 5.5°\) per minute
The minute hand gains \(5.5°\) every minute

questions.stem: At what rate does the minute hand gain on the hour hand per hour?
questions.keySolution:
Relative speed = \(5.5°\) per minute
Per hour = \(5.5 × 60 = 330°\) per hour

questions.stem: Which statement about clock hand speeds is correct?
options: Minute hand moves at \(6°\) per minute while hour hand moves at \(0.5°\) per minute
Speeds depend on time of day
questions.keySolution:
Minute hand: \(360° / 60 min = 6° / min\)
Hour hand: \(360° / (12 × 60) min = 0.5° / min\)

questions.stem: If the minute hand is at \(12\) and we want the hands to meet next, how many minutes must pass?
questions.keySolution:
When minute hand is at \(12\), the next meeting depends on hour hand position
Generally, hands meet every \(720/11 ≈ 65.45\) minutes
